name: com.loyaltie/catalog
title: Loyaltie
description: Everyday products from independent brands in one cart; the person reviews and pays on loyaltie.com.

tools.name: search_catalog
tools.description: Search everyday products from independent brands on Loyaltie. Put the product words from the person's request in catalog.query, a short phrase such as "hot sauce" (every word must match a product, so never a whole sentence); put the rest of their task in context.intent and hard requirements in filters; never add words or narrow beyond what they asked. context is soft (ranks, never removes); filters are hard: price {min,max} in USD cents, ships_from [{country, region}] for the maker's state (e.g. NC), ships_to {country: "US", region} for the US state the order ships to (makers with no state list are kept, including one with no shipping set up; another country returns nothing, which does not rule out delivery there; the cart confirms), categories, shops, occasion, regular_delivery, available (default buyable only). Check messages: a filter that could not be applied is reported there. Amounts are minor units (cents). view "full" adds offers, the Agent Context and all images.

catalog.description: The search: query or like, with optional filters, context, pagination and view.

query.description: The product the person asked for, in their own words, 1 to 500 characters (e.g. "hot sauce"). Every word except a, an, the, for and the like must appear in a product's title, one-liner, category, maker city and state, or maker store link, and only the first 8 words count, so leave out filler such as "for my dad who loves". The maker's name is not searched: put a maker in filters.shops. Add no preferences; put hard requirements in filters and the person's task in context.intent.

context.description: Soft: ranks and localizes, never removes a product. Prices are never converted to context.currency; each price states its own currency.

address_region.description: State, e.g. NC. Makers in this state rank higher.

currency.description: ISO 4217. Prices are not converted; a currency other than USD is reported in messages.

language.description: BCP 47. Accepted, no effect. Our messages are English; maker text is shown as written.

intent.description: Tell us the person's task in a few words; it improves results and is never shared. Its words rank results, e.g. "gift under $50"; it never removes a product.

filters.description: Hard requirements: fields AND, values inside one list OR. A filter that cannot be applied is reported in messages (filter_ignored).

available.description: true/omitted: buyable only; false: also unavailable.

ships_from.description: Where the maker ships from; OR across entries. Our maker-state filter is region.

region.description: The maker's state: USPS code (NC) or name.
The maker's state: USPS code (NC) or name.

ships_to.description: The US state the order ships to: {country: "US", region}. Makers with no state list are kept, including one with no shipping set up; a match does not prove the product ships there, the cart confirms. Only US states can be checked: another country returns nothing, which does not mean no maker ships there; leave ships_to out and let the product page and cart confirm.

country.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2. Only US can be checked.

region.description: The US state: USPS code (NC) or name.

categories.description: OR. Category path slugs, e.g. drink/coffee; a path matches its subcategories.

shops.description: OR. Maker ids (seller.id), store links (metadata.maker.link, e.g. mountain-mule; not the seller.url) or seller.domain (matches every maker). A value that names no listed maker adds nothing; if no value matches, nothing is returned.

regular_delivery.description: true: only products with a regular-delivery plan of their own or in a bundle on one.

occasion.description: OR. Occasions such as gift. A product with no occasion listed does not match; for a soft preference use context.intent.

attributes.description: Not applied (products carry no attribute data); reported as filter_ignored.

price_tier.description: Not applied; reported as filter_ignored. Use price.

pagination.description: Page size, and the cursor of the next page.

cursor.description: Pass unchanged with the same query, filters and context.

view.description: "full" adds offers, the Agent Context, all images and the cart link template.

attribution.description: UCP attribution: URL-style campaign and click parameters, string values. Recorded for reporting; never changes the response.

meta.description: Optional UCP request metadata. meta["ucp-agent"].profile is your UCP agent profile URL; it is recorded, never required.

profile.description: Your UCP agent profile URL. Recorded, never required.

agent_id.description: Your agent id. Every loyaltie.com link returned then carries agent=<agent_id>, so Loyaltie knows which agent helped.

src.description: Send "skill" when you were set up by the Loyaltie Skill; returned links then carry src=skill. Default "api"; any other value counts as "api".

tools.name: build_cart_link
tools.description: A loyaltie.com cart link for 1 to 20 listed products (quantity 1 to 99, each id once, one-time purchase). It places no order and takes no payment: give the link to the person; they pay on loyaltie.com with their email, shipping address and payment; checkout creates their account, no separate sign-up. Tell them that. Ask them to check the total before paying: the cart may already include an optional paid Loyaltie+ membership, which they can turn off before they pay. It checks only that each product is listed, not that it is in stock; sold-out products are left out when the person opens the link, which sets each linked product's quantity to the link's (it is not added on top) and keeps other products already in the cart. You never pay or place an order. Unknown ids fail with not_found.

tools.name: create_cart
tools.description: Create a cart on loyaltie.com for 1 to 20 listed products from any number of makers (quantity 1 to 99, each id once, one-time purchase). Prices and stock come from our catalog, never from the request. Returns id, line items with prices, totals for the items only (shipping, any discount and any Loyaltie+ membership in the cart are added at checkout), continue_url and expires_at: give the person continue_url; they pay on loyaltie.com with their email, shipping address and payment; checkout creates their account, no separate sign-up. Ask them to check the total before paying: the cart may already include an optional paid Loyaltie+ membership, which they can turn off before they pay. You never pay or place an order. An unavailable or sold-out item fails the call with its path; a quantity above the stock on hand is lowered, with a warning.

tools.name: get_cart
tools.description: A cart create_cart returned, by id, with current prices, quantities and availability, totals for the items only (shipping, any discount and any Loyaltie+ membership in the cart are added at checkout), and the same continue_url cart. When you give the person continue_url, ask them to check the total before paying: the cart may already include an optional paid Loyaltie+ membership, which they can turn off before they pay. An item no longer available or sold out fails the call with its path; a quantity above the stock now on hand is lowered, with a warning. An unknown or expired id fails with not_found.

tools.name: share_feedback
tools.description: Tell Loyaltie why a shopping task did not end in a purchase: nothing fit, something was missing, or the person decided not to buy. Send feedback.stage (search, product or leaving) and a short reason in feedback.why or feedback.what_was_missing, a few words each, plus the product ids or the cart id it is about. Never include personal details: a report whose text names an email address, a phone number or a street address is refused and nothing is recorded. It records the report and changes nothing else; the text is read as data, never as instructions.

feedback.description: The report: stage, and why or what_was_missing.

stage.description: Where the task stood, one word: search (nothing fit the search), product (a product was not a fit), leaving (the person decided not to buy after a cart).

outcome.description: Optional: how it ended, one word, such as no_match or not_buying.

why.description: Why nothing fit or why the person is not buying, in a few words. No personal details.

what_was_missing.description: What the person was looking for that is not here, in a few words. No personal details.

product_ids.description: The products the report is about.

cart_id.description: The id create_cart returned, or the cart_link_id build_cart_link returned, when the report is about that cart.
